convertibility_reason: Multi-currency/multi-symbol framework using custom symbol iteration with SymbolInfoDouble/SymbolInfoInteger for dynamic symbol properties, complex multi-symbol position management, and template-style architecture requiring manual adaptation of symbol selection logic

other_exits: Template EA - no exit logic implemented, placeholder for user-defined exit rules

custom_logic_notes: Multi-currency template EA that iterates over a configurable list of symbols (input Symb[]). Uses SymbolInfoDouble and SymbolInfoInteger for dynamic point/digits retrieval per symbol. Implements new bar detection per symbol, spread normalization (_Point*10 adjustment for 5-digit), and per-symbol position counting. No actual trading signals are implemented - this is a framework/template designed for users to add their own entry/exit indicator logic. Contains helper functions for trade operations (OpenBuy, OpenSell, CloseBuy, CloseSell) with retry logic and error handling.
python_conversion_notes: This is a multi-currency template with no actual signal logic. Key conversion considerations: (1) Symbol iteration loop must be preserved - each bar check iterates all configured symbols; (2) Per-symbol new bar detection uses iClose comparison across bars; (3) Point/digits normalization dynamically reads SymbolInfoDouble(Symbol, SYMBOL_POINT) and SymbolInfoInteger(Symbol, SYMBOL_DIGITS) - Python equivalent is ccxt or broker API symbol info fetch; (4) Spread normalization multiplies SL/TP by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001; (5) Position counting is per-symbol using PositionsTotal() with symbol filter; (6) Trade retry logic with sleep must be adapted to broker API rate limits; (7) ORDER_TYPE_FILLING selection logic (FOK/IOC/RETURN) based on SymbolInfoInteger(SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE) needs broker capability check; (8) The template structure with empty signal blocks means Python version should also be a template with clear insertion points for signal logic.
